method: last party primary voted in (the 2026 primaries and May runoffs (in Harris, Dallas and Tarrant counties, 2024's too, from the counties' own rosters)), from official rosters matched voter by voter to the 2026 general's early-voting and mail rosters

Denton.supplement: Denton County Elections' early-voting and returned-mail rosters

El Paso.supplement: El Paso County Elections' early-voting and mail lists

Tarrant.supplement: Tarrant County Elections' in-person and mail rosters
